issues.title: Your text is too hard to read
issues.desc: Low-contrast text on your homepage. People with low vision cannot read it.

issues.title: Your forms confuse blind visitors
issues.desc: Contact and intake forms have no labels. Screen readers can't identify the fields.

issues.title: Four nav links go nowhere
issues.desc: Vehicle Accidents, Personal Injury, Areas Served, and Resources are dead links.

issues.title: Links blend into text
issues.desc: Hyperlinks rely on color only. Colorblind visitors don't know what's clickable.

issues.title: Maps and widgets are invisible
issues.desc: Embedded contact widgets have no labels for assistive technologies.

issues.title: Mystery links with no name
issues.desc: Some links have no text. Screen readers announce only "link" with no context.
